source.html:
Lentil Soup with Ham
 
Save Print
Author: Olivia House
Recipe type: Dinner
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) olive oil
  • 2 Cup(s) Dried brown lentils
  • 2 carrot, chopped
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 3 Clove(s) minced garlic
  • ½ Cup(s) white wine
  • 7 Cup(s) chicken broth
  • 1 Teaspoon(s) fresh thyme, minced
  • 1 bay leaves
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) red pepper flakes
  • 2 Cup(s) diced cooked ham
  • ½ Pound(s) Kale, stemmed and leaves chopped
Instructions
  1. Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium heat until shimmering. Add lentils, carrots, and onion and cook until vegetables are softened and lentils are beginning to brown, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add wine and cook until reduced by half, about 1 minute. Stir in broth, thyme, bay leaf, and pepper flakes and bring to boil.
  2. Reduce heat to medium low, and simmer, covered, until thickened and lentils are completely tender, about 1 hour. Discard bay leaf. Puree 2 cups soup until smooth. Return pureed soup to pot and stir in kale and ham. Simmer, covered, until kale is tender, about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Serve.
